_notes: This example ships no docker-compose.yml, so the smoke runner
(which gates on a compose file) does not pick it up. The reason is
the build, not the stack: the meter reporter lives behind the
payment-stripe cargo feature and Dockerfile.cloudbuild compiles the
default set, so the shared image would start this config and fail
on the configured reporter. Build with --features payment-stripe
and run fixture.py beside it, as the README shows.
cases[] is empty rather than guessed. The interesting outcome here
is not an HTTP status: it is the row that lands in the usage_reports
table of the SQLite file at proxy.payments.state_path, which the
smoke runner has no way to read. bin/bill-one-call.sh mints the key,
bills one call, and prints the row count.
e2e/tests/usage_bridge.rs asserts the same outcomes automatically:
it starts at an HTTP request through the harness and finishes by
reading the same SQLite file, so a producer that disappears again
audit_check stays false until the OSS /api/audit/recent endpoint
